title: Read a copied architecture snapshot offline
goal: Understand a shared architecture without the original author environment.
context: A complete snapshot has been explicitly shared with the reviewer.
trigger: The reviewer opens the copied output without network access.
preconditions: The selected scope and any available project or artifact identity are explicitly identified.

interaction.action: Opens the copied snapshot in a supported reading environment.
Provides view navigation, diagrams and required selected source detail offline.
Checks source identity and available rationale.
Identifies the captured state and explains that live freshness is not established.

expected_outcome: The reviewer understands the captured architecture and its limits without source checkout or generator.

alternatives.condition: An optional external source link is unavailable.
alternatives.outcome: Included required explanation remains readable; the link limitation is visible.

failures.condition: The received copy lacks required reading resources.
failures.outcome: The missing content is diagnosed where detectable; an incomplete copy is not presented as complete.

sources.locator: SCN-084; confirmed as requirement-analysis knowledge by the scoped author assessment, not independent review or executed product proof.
sources.basis: User-requested reusable customer architecture browser; requirement-level author analysis. Current records remain draft; no implemented, published or independently approved behavior is claimed.
